title: tradeskillframe
summary: MSUI's current TradeSkillFrame is a law-positioned 384x512 player profession panel with the stock rank StatusBar, exact eight-row faux-scroll controls, created-item (ItemClass, ItemSubClass) groups named verbose-first from ItemSubClass.dbc, tier/item-level/name sorting, authored fold headers and Collapse All tab, exact overlapping subclass/inventory UIDropDownMenu capsules, product/list/reagent tooltips, have/need reagents and tool/focus gates, plus typed bounded repeat count, Create All, Create and Exit/Cancel batch behavior. The centered title uses GameFontNormal. The split GameFontHighlightSmall Requires label/text occupies the exact recipe-header seat; carried tools use inline red when missing and the spell-focus name remains uncolored. Production geometry is owned by ProfessionFrameUiLaw and the shared DropdownCapsuleUiLaw; focused and full interface-wire suites pass.

openItems.text: Flat recipe list: no collapsible subclass group headers (+/- fold rows), no Collapse All button
openItems.resolution: ProfessionFrameUiLaw.BuildTradeSkillTree groups created products by (ItemClass, ItemSubClass), sorts group entries by difficulty tier/product item level/name, emits +/- header rows, and applies persistent per-group and Collapse All state.

openItems.text: No filter dropdowns (subclass filter, inventory-slot filter)
openItems.resolution: The two law-positioned TradeSkill dropdown controls select an ItemSubClass group or the exact byte-confirmed InventoryType-derived slot bit; empty groups disappear under filtering.

openItems.text: Skill rank shows as text 'value / max' with no status-bar fill (ref TradeSkillRankFrame is a StatusBar)
openItems.resolution: DrawProfessionRankBar paints the exact shared 268x15 blue skill StatusBar and stock border with line name plus value/max text.

openItems.text: List scrolls by mouse wheel only - no scrollbar widget on the recipe list (the trainer window has one; this one does not)
openItems.resolution: DrawProfessionScrollBar provides the 16px cropped stock up/down buttons and draggable knob for the law-bounded eight-row faux list, alongside wheel scrolling.

openItems.text: No item tooltips on the product icon or reagent rows
openItems.resolution: TradeSkill recipe rows, selected product icon, and each reagent row now publish ItemTemplate snapshots through the existing shared GameTooltip owner arbitration.

openItems.text: No creation-count spinner (ref's number input with +/- and the typed count next to Create)
openItems.resolution: The TradeSkill-only three-digit vanilla input with decrement/increment buttons clamps to current material availability and latches that count into the existing one-cast-at-a-time batch machine.

openItems.text: TradeSkill requirements were rendered as separate generic ImGui Tool/Requires lines after the reagent grid instead of current Benilla's split GameFontHighlightSmall Requires label and colored tool list directly below the recipe name.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ProfessionFrameUiLaw now owns the exact header seat, font identity, four-pixel label/text gap, and colored requirement-name grammar. Missing carried tools are red, the spell-focus name stays uncolored, and the old post-reagent generic lines are removed. Enchanting/CraftFrame and crafting readiness are unchanged. Focused ProfessionFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: The TradeSkillFrame title used a hand-picked generic 14px ImGui font instead of the authored centered GameFontNormal FontString.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ProfessionFrameUiLaw now owns the GameFontNormal title identity and the renderer consumes it at the existing exact title center. Focused ProfessionFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: TradeSkill recipe-row and selected-product tooltips used the shared default floating tooltip position instead of the authored ANCHOR_RIGHT owner seats.
openItems.resolution: ProfessionFrameUiLaw now owns the shared ANCHOR_RIGHT seat used by Craft and TradeSkill. Recipe rows and the detail product anchor tooltip bottom-left to owner top-right; reagent ANCHOR_TOPLEFT behavior remains intact. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Pending tool and spell-focus catalogs leaked synthetic Item <id> and Spell Focus <id> labels into TradeSkillFrame's visible Requires line; Benilla omits unresolved names.
openItems.resolution: ProfessionFrameUiLaw now owns resolved requirement-name admission. TradeSkillFrame omits pending tool/focus names and paints them when resolved, without changing carried-tool, focus-proximity, or craft-readiness gates. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: TradeSkill Collapse All was painted as a generic panel button with '+ All'/'− All' copy instead of the authored three-piece tab, separate plus/minus texture, additive hover texture, and small All label; mixed fold state also expanded instead of collapsing all.
openItems.resolution: ProfessionFrameUiLaw owns the exact 54x32 tab artwork, 40x22 hit seat, 16x16 fold icon, small-font label center, and texture identities. The shared renderer consumes those rules, and mixed state now follows Benilla's all-collapsed predicate: any expanded header yields the minus icon and collapses every group on click. Focused ProfessionFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: TradeSkill subclass and inventory filters used generic panel-button rectangles instead of the authored overlapping UIDropDownMenuTemplate capsules and arrow-only toggle controls.
openItems.resolution: The shared DropdownCapsuleUiLaw owns the reference end-cap/middle art slices, fixed selection box, arrow button states, hover art, and sound identity. ProfessionFrameUiLaw owns the exact TOPRIGHT inventory capsule and overlapping subclass capsule anchors; the existing filter choices and menu behavior are unchanged. Focused ProfessionFrame/UiFoundation and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: TradeSkill's open subclass and inventory filters used custom dark/gold boxes, textual checkmarks, and 18px rows offset from their capsules instead of UIDropDownMenu's anchored dialog lists and 16px checked rows.
openItems.resolution: Both filter lists now derive directly from their DropdownCapsuleUiLaw layouts and consume the exact fixed 120px row width, 15px borders, dialog backdrop, selected check plus locked additive highlight, hover highlight, GameFontHighlightSmall label seat, and UChatScrollButton selection cue. Existing subclass/inventory choices, single selection, close-on-pick, and scroll reset remain unchanged. Focused ProfessionFrame checks pass.
